thread:
Jordan Chen: FYI — Elena (customer) hit a 401 invalid_api_key after using the dashboard 'Export' copy button. She says the key pasted into her app is shorter than what's shown when she clicks 'Show'. Repro steps below, reproduced on our side too.

Support Bot: New ticket created: INC-12345 (attached logs from customer).

Priya Patel: Quick Qs — which browser/OS? raw Authorization header? Any extra whitespace when they paste? Could be copy truncation or hidden chars.

Elena (customer): macOS 13.4, Safari 16.4. I clicked Export -> Copy and pasted into my app's env var. App got 401 immediately. When I click Show in the dashboard and copy manually, the key is longer and works. Attached screenshots.

Jordan Chen: Reproduced on staging with Safari. The exported widget visually wraps the key over two lines; the copy button appears to copy only the visible first line in Safari, resulting in a 31-char value instead of 32. Also saw a trailing newline when copy-pasting into Terminal. Repro curl I used:

```bash
# pasted key is surrounded by <> so you can see length markers
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer <sk_live_ABCDEFGH1234567890ABCDEF>" \n  -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.internal/v1/engines/text:generate \n  -d '{"input":"hi"}'
```

Priya Patel: Nice catch. Can you paste the literal header they sent (replace secret with X):

`Authorization: Bearer sk_live_ABCDEFGH1234567890ABCDE`

(That last char is missing — confirms truncation.)

Infra SRE: I've queried logs for that org id — 5 failed requests with short-key pattern in last 40m, all from Safari clients. Recommend telling customer to rotate the key (quick mitigation) and use the 'Show' flow until we patch. I've added a temporary server-side check to return a clearer error when key length != expected: `invalid_api_key_length`. Ops runbook updated.

Jordan Chen: Filed frontend bug FE-842 — Safari copy-on-wrap bug in export modal. Assigning to @frontend-team, ETA 3d. Workaround told to customer: click Show, select entire key, or use dashboard Download -> secret file. Also advised trimming whitespace on paste: `value.trim()` — many apps include the newline.

Elena (customer): Thanks — rotated, confirmed new key works. Appreciate the quick help 🙂

Priya Patel: Closing loop — follow-up: add unit test for copy button with long keys and add explicit copy-to-clipboard code (no reliance on selection rectangle). Also tracking to update docs: "If you see 401 immediately after copy, try Show then copy."

Jordan Chen: Marking thread resolved. Will attach repro screenshots and FE-842 link to INC-12345. :thumbsup:
